Today is May 18, 2023. "This or the last month" means May 2023 or April 2023. Let me log into Venmo.
Now let me get the pending payment requests and also my payment cards to find the one ending in 1102.

Let me check for more pages of pending requests.

The card ending in 1102 is the Discover card (card_number ends with 1102) - payment_card_id: 465.

Now, "this or the last month" - current month is May 2023, last month is April 2023. So I need to approve requests created in April or May 2023.

Wait - these are payment requests I've received, meaning people are requesting money FROM me. So I need to approve them (pay them). Let me approve them all.

content: The card doesn't have enough funds. Let me check my Venmo balance first - maybe I can use the Venmo balance instead.
I have $1058 in my Venmo balance. Let me try approving without specifying a card (which will use Venmo balance).
All 15 payment requests approved using Venmo balance. Now let me check the remaining balance and withdraw it to the card ending in 1102 (Discover, payment_card_id: 465).

Let me calculate: Starting balance was $1058. Total approved payments:
May: 9+10+14+49+23+10 = $115
April: 51+26+92+156+21+19+18+50+23 = $456
Total: $115 + $456 = $571
Remaining: $1058 - $571 = $487. That matches.

Now let me withdraw the remaining $487 to the Discover card (ending in 1102).
All done! Let me complete the task.
